documented_probe: C-3376e488 (implement a gated-transformation Triton kernel with RMSNorm matching a PyTorch reference; min difficulty medium): the task requires a single @triton.jit kernel using only triton.language ops that reproduces a tanh-gated blend with a +1.0 shift plus per-row RMS rescaling in float32, with the masked-lane reduction trap (padded lanes become 1.0 after the shift and must be excluded from the mean square) and hidden shape/seed/eps cases checked against an independent torch reference.
notes: Two deliverables: the Triton kernel module and a runnable self-check. Medium floor from kernel correctness under CPU-interpreter mode (masked loads/stores, in-kernel reduction, tl-only ops), numerics matching within 1e-4 on fresh hidden shapes including D=1, non-power-of-two D and D=1024, and determinism. No environment pressure; modest tool breadth (triton/torch).
